title: SPIN — VR Table Tennis
desc: Table tennis in a night arena, playable in VR right from the browser. In a headset your controller is the paddle; on desktop you play with the mouse.
features: Runs in the browser — VR headsets via WebXR, or desktop with mouse and keyboard
Three opponent levels: Rookie, Pro and Legend
Swing your controller as the paddle and tap menu buttons with it
Optional aim assist, live scoreboard, crowd arena and music
